meta.title: Burp MCP connector
meta.description: Both HTTP sending routes stay on the same MCP tools: mcp__burp__send_http1_request/send_http2_request default to route=proxy through Burp Proxy 8080. route=extension invokes the real Burp MCP at http://127.0.0.1:9876/mcp using its original extension HTTP API, still sent by Burp and viewed in Logger, not non-Burp direct traffic. Proxy uses Proxy Intercept; extension keeps original MCP HTTP approval. No automatic route fallback. Other MCP tools remain. Dedicated Chrome remains optional. Manage in sidebar Plugins; edit cordis.patch.yml for configuration. Tool discovery is a startup snapshot; reconnect after changes.
